parts.text: I bought a coffee maker online 18 days ago with my order receipt. Can I still return it for a full refund?
Yes, standard items can be returned within 30 days of purchase with receipt for a full refund to the original payment method.
I purchased wireless noise-canceling headphones 22 days ago. Can I return them for a refund?
Electronics and smart devices must be returned within 14 days of purchase. Because 22 days have passed, they are not eligible for a return or refund unless covered by warranty.
I bought an outdoor jacket marked as 'Final Sale Clearance'. Can I exchange it or get store credit?
Items marked as Final Sale or Clearance cannot be returned, refunded, or exchanged under any circumstances.
I received a backpack as a gift and do not have the receipt or order number. Can I get cash back?
Returns without a receipt cannot receive cash refunds. They are eligible for store credit at the current lowest selling price with a valid photo ID.
My cart total is $42. How much more do I need to spend to get free standard shipping?
Standard shipping is free on orders over $50. With a cart of $42, you need $8 more to qualify for free shipping.
My blender stopped turning on 8 months after purchase. Does Cymbal Retail cover repairs or replacement?
All non-electronic appliances carry a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturer defects. Since it is 8 months old, Cymbal Retail will repair or replace it with proof of purchase.
